cohort: The study participants were 1,517,525 women with normal prepregnancy BMI (18.5-24.9 kg/m2) who had singleton deliveries and 6,138 infant deaths.
finding: Neither insufficient nor excessive gestational weight gain, relative to adequate GWG, was associated with an increased risk of infant death during the first year of life among women with normal prepregnancy BMI.
gest_age: All gestational ages, with specific analysis for term and preterm deliveries.
